forecast_contract.trigger: one natural atomic news publication strictly after 2026-07-31T19:16:52Z
forecast_contract.market_clock: latest completed MCL five-minute TRADES bar no more than 300 seconds old
forecast_contract.ta_owner: preceding four-hour MCL impulse whose last-thirty-minute directional progress no longer exceeds its prior hourly rate
forecast_contract.news_role: absolute signed pressure at least 0.80 classifies persistence and convexity only
forecast_contract.population: freeze both extreme and nonextreme TA onsets before their outcomes
forecast_contract.settlement: one immutable result containing 30m, 60m, and 240m return, MFE, MAE, range, and excursion timing

runtime_contract.owner: one read-only systemd OnSuccess companion to tradebot-news.service
runtime_contract.idempotence: LiveCalibrationLedger content addresses one forecast per publication and one result per forecast
runtime_contract.failure: news publication remains successful; companion retries independently and fails closed
